data.long_meaning: From the Latin word 'foris' meaning 'outside' and 'stare' meaning 'to stand'. A name meaning 'strong keeper' or 'protector from outside forces'. In Christian tradition, Forster is also associated with St. Foster, an Irish monk known for his hospitality and care for travelers. The name Forster carries the meaning “Strong keeper” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Forster usually hope their child will grow to embody strong keeper and live with faith, good character and purpose.
